title: Victorian Default Offer
summary: Under an Order in Council made under s 13 of the Electricity Industry Act 2000 (published 30 May 2019), Victoria replaced retailer-set standing offers with an ESC-determined Victorian Default Offer from 1 July 2019, plus best-offer messaging rules.

instruments.title: Electricity Industry Act 2000 s 13 Order in Council (Victorian Default Offer)
instruments.register_id: Victoria Government Gazette No. S 208, 30 May 2019

commenced.what: VDO tariffs applied to standing offer customers

direction_rationale: Re-regulating the default price constrains standing-offer pricing and may narrow margins for entrants, while simplifying comparisons for consumers.
